scope: One wallet and frozen snapshot; only configured historical events. Each event is filtered to [observation_start_utc, min(selection_cutoff_utc, decision_cutoff_utc)).
multiplicity: Participant-record multiplicity is retained. Transaction hashes are counted as sets only for transaction/day/gap features; they are not fill keys.
missingness: All 30 behavioural values are missing when any requested historical event has incomplete query coverage. observed_participant_rows separately records retrieved-row lower bounds. A complete empty history has zero count/sum features and missing undefined ratios/gaps.
numerics: Source decimal strings are retained in trade exports; derived feature calculations use floating point. Quantiles use pandas default linear interpolation.
preprocessing: Only the eight clustering candidates enter the model. Constant or zero-IQR candidates are removed with an explicit report. Listed log1p transforms precede RobustScaler fitted on eligible frozen histories only.

features.name: active_days
features.definition: Number of distinct UTC dates containing distinct observed wallet transactions in the allowed historical trade window.

features.name: transactions_per_active_day
features.definition: Number of distinct transaction hashes divided by active_days; missing when active_days is zero.

features.name: median_trade_notional_usd
features.definition: Median shares times price across participant records. This is a per-record size, not a per-transaction trade size or PnL.

features.name: events_traded
features.definition: Number of queried historical events with at least one allowed participant record.

features.name: median_event_top_market_fraction
features.definition: For each participated event with positive total notional, divide the largest market notional by event total notional; take the median across those events. Undefined zero-notional events are omitted; missing if all are undefined.

features.name: two_sided_token_fraction
features.definition: Number of observed market/token pairs containing both BUY and SELL participant records divided by the number of observed market/token pairs. This does not establish market making or arbitrage.

features.name: busiest_day_transaction_fraction
features.definition: Maximum count of distinct transactions on one UTC day divided by all distinct transactions. A transaction occurring in multiple records is counted once, at its earliest observed timestamp.

features.name: median_transaction_gap_hours
features.definition: Median elapsed hours between successive distinct transaction timestamps, using the earliest observed timestamp for each transaction. Includes overnight and inter-event gaps; missing with fewer than two transactions.

features.name: participant_rows
features.definition: Count of accepted API participant records retained in the feature window, preserving multiplicity.

features.name: unique_transactions
features.definition: Count of distinct transaction hashes across all allowed historical events and markets for this wallet.

features.name: gross_shares
features.definition: Sum of positive shares across all allowed participant records, including both BUY and SELL and YES and NO.

features.name: gross_participant_notional_usd
features.definition: Sum of shares times price across allowed participant records, excluding fees. Not market-wide volume, invested capital, revenue or PnL.

features.name: max_daily_transaction_count
features.definition: Maximum number of distinct wallet transactions on one UTC date; uses earliest observed timestamp per transaction.

features.name: p90_trade_notional_usd
features.definition: 90th percentile of participant-record shares times price, using pandas linear quantile interpolation.

features.name: median_trade_shares
features.definition: Median gross participant-record shares across allowed records.

features.name: markets_traded
features.definition: Number of distinct binary outcome markets with at least one allowed participant record. Several markets in one Fed meeting remain one event.

features.name: event_participation_fraction
features.definition: events_traded divided by the number of queried historical event IDs, including complete zero-activity events in the denominator.

features.name: top_event_notional_fraction
features.definition: Largest summed event notional divided by total historical wallet notional; missing when total notional is zero.

features.name: median_event_outcome_entropy
features.definition: Within each positive-notional participated event, calculate minus sum(p_market * log(p_market)) divided by log(number of mapped outcome markets in that event), where p_market is its share of wallet event notional. Untraded markets contribute zero; take the median over defined events. A one-market universe has entropy zero.

features.name: buy_share_fraction
features.definition: Sum of shares on BUY records divided by gross_shares; missing with zero gross shares.

features.name: yes_token_share_fraction
features.definition: Sum of shares on YES-token records divided by gross_shares; YES refers to each separate outcome market, not a common policy direction.

features.name: buy_yes_shares
features.definition: Sum of shares for BUY YES records across feature markets; descriptive component, not an aggregate policy preference.

features.name: sell_yes_shares
features.definition: Sum of shares for SELL YES records across feature markets.

features.name: buy_no_shares
features.definition: Sum of shares for BUY NO records across feature markets.

features.name: sell_no_shares
features.definition: Sum of shares for SELL NO records across feature markets.

features.name: absolute_market_netting_ratio
features.definition: For each event/market calculate D = BUY YES - SELL YES + SELL NO - BUY NO in shares; sum abs(D) across markets and divide by total gross_shares. Missing with zero gross shares; not holdings or accuracy.

features.name: p90_transaction_gap_hours
features.definition: 90th percentile of successive distinct-transaction elapsed hours using pandas linear quantile interpolation; includes inter-event gaps.

features.name: days_since_last_trade
features.definition: Snapshot cutoff minus last allowed historical trade timestamp, expressed as elapsed seconds divided by 86400; missing with no observed trades. Refers to queried history only, not platform-wide recency.

features.name: observed_span_days
features.definition: Latest minus earliest allowed historical trade timestamp, in seconds divided by 86400; missing with no observed trades.

features.name: active_week_fraction
features.definition: Distinct Monday-through-Sunday calendar weeks with an allowed trade divided by distinct such weeks touched by the entire [observation_start, snapshot_cutoff) calendar interval. Partial boundary weeks count once.
